summary: Iter23 - Full review of Staff/Volunteer personal area 'La mia partecipazione'. Backend: 3/3 pytest passed. Frontend E2E on preview covering all 11 review points passed. VolunteerEvent.jsx OP_STATO map hides 'da_contattare' - the state badge only renders when a whitelisted state is present. Confirmed 'Confermato' badge shows in both dashboard and detail.

RouteMapDialog.jsx: GPX fetch via credentials:'include' works with httpOnly cookie; Leaflet renders polyline + OSM tiles (20 tiles loaded). Dialog missing aria-describedby warning surfaces (radix Dialog) - minor accessibility improvement.
Minor perf: Leaflet Canvas2D warns 'willReadFrequently' repeatedly; harmless but noisy. Consider setting the attribute on renderer canvas.
